'''Lolaniso Ibrohimovna Ismoilova''' ({{langx|tg|'''Лоланисо Иброҳимовна Исмоилова'''}}; 4 October 1929 – 11 December 2012) was a Tajikistani biologist, active during the [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] era.

==Life and career==
Born into a working-class family in [[Dushanbe]], Ismoilova graduated from the Department of Biology of the [[Tajikistan State University]] in 1953. In 1965 she joined the [[Communist Party of the Soviet Union]]. She became an assistant professor in the Department of [[Histology]] at the University in 1970, and in 1974 was promoted to become head of the Department of Biology and General Genetics of the Tajikistan State Medical Institute. She received a doctoral degree in biology in 1986. As a researcher, Ismoilova concerned herself with the structure and function of [[lymph node]]s once they had been subjected to fire.<ref name="fayllar.org">{{cite web|url=http://fayllar.org/p-rominent-t-ajik-f-igures-of-the.html?page=16|title=Iraj Bashiri - Prominent tajik figures of the|website=fayllar.org|accessdate=24 November 2017}}</ref> She also studied post-traumatic postnatal issues, and did work on the restoration and transplantation of blood vessels in [[kidney]]s.<ref name="tajmedun.tj">{{cite web|url=http://old.tajmedun.tj/publ/ehnciklopedija/i/ismoilova_lolaniso_ibro_imovna/12-1-0-2432|title=ИСМОИЛОВА Лоланисо Иброҳимовна - И - Энциклопедия - Каталог статей - ТГМУ имени Абуали ибни Сино|website=old.tajmedun.tj|accessdate=24 November 2017}}</ref> Among her publications are ''Environmental Upkeep and People's Health'' (1984) and ''A Short Russian-Tajiki-Dari Dictionary of Biology'' (Dushanbe, 1973).<ref name="fayllar.org"/> She published over 180 articles and papers during her career, including 24 instructional methods and two textbooks.<ref name="tajmedun.tj"/>

Ismoilova died in [[Dushanbe]] on 11 December 2012, at the age of 83.<ref>{{cite news |title=В Таджикистане простились с самой красивой женщиной времен СССР |url=https://www.azattyqasia.org/a/the-most-beautiful-tajik-woman-usssr-times-died/24796367.html |access-date=25 October 2026 |publisher=azattyqasia.org |date=12 December 2012}}</ref>
